input.message: I am sick of this family plan nonsense. I got an email saying 'Your account will be suspended due to non-payment unless you update your card immediately.' So I logged in and tried to swap my expired Visa for my new Amex, but the system just keeps spinning. The email says I have 24 hours before they charge me a $50 late fee on top of the $299 renewal. I don't care about the stupid email warnings or what the automated note says about suspension; I just need to update my payment method so I isn't charged extra. Why is your billing page broken? Fix the charge issue now. I've been a customer for five years and this is ridiculous. Just let me pay the bill with the new card.
app say stranger login but my bro definitely did it. i wanna cancel my membership right now.

Customer: hey so my boss forwarded me this sketchy email sayin 'your gym pro account is compromised, cancel immediately to avoid fraud' lol sounds fake but he wants me to kill the sub just in case. honestly tho i wanna keep the membership for the team, just need to stop the auto-renewal on the corporate card cause we switching vendors next month.
Agent: got it, saw the forwarded note. you want to keep access but stop the renewal cycle?
Customer: yeah exactly, dont cancel the whole thing yet, just halt the renewal date so we dont get charged again. the email says cancel but im ignoring that part, priority is stopping the next bill.
